label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 078 ]

blocks.text: The doctor's receptionist was startled when a nun stormed out of the examining room and left without paying. When the doctor appeared she asked what had happened. "Well." said the doctor, "I examined her and told her she was pregnant." "Doctor!" exclaimed the receptionist. "That can't be!" "Of course not." he replied, "but it sure cured her hiccups."

readingSentences.english: The doctor's receptionist was startled when a nun stormed out of the examining room and left without paying.
readingSentences.korean: 그 의사의 수납 간호사는 어떤 수녀가 진료실에서 쏜살같이 뛰어 나오더니 돈을 내지 않고 떠나버리는 것을 보고 놀랐다.

readingSentences.english: When the doctor appeared she asked what had happened. "Well." said the doctor, "I examined her and told her she was pregnant." "Doctor!" exclaimed the receptionist.
readingSentences.korean: 그 의사가 나타나자 그녀는 무슨일이 있었느냐고 물었다 ."글쌔"그 의사는 말하기를,"나는 그녀(수녀)를 진찰했고 그리고는 그녀가 임신했다고 말했지.""선생님!그것은 불가능 해요라고 간호사는 소리쳤다.

readingSentences.english: "That can't be!" "Of course not." he replied, "but it sure cured her hiccups."
readingSentences.korean: 물론 아니지만 그것은 확실히 그녀의 딸꾹질을 치료했지라고 의사는 답했다.
